compiled_native_HMMA.scope: Native BF16 HMMA plus compiled NOP, wait controls, loop, and accumulator reduction. These are effective sequence costs, not bare instruction latency.
compiled_native_HMMA.aggregate_saturation_prior: About one native operation per eight SM cycles across four active warps in this compiled probe.

aggregate_streaming_copy.scope: Read-plus-write traffic, ten large device copies per event. Correctness sampled at four words per repetition. Use the measured byte/s rate for the same aggregate traffic convention.

compiled_GEMM_interaction.unit: fraction of the smaller net phase cost
compiled_GEMM_interaction.scope: 32x32 tile; one matched calibration case, two K3072 confirmation workloads; not an identified overlap fraction of a hardware pipeline.
